paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.75% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-0.90%) and Nasdaq weakest (-6.87%). Brent crude changed -2.81% to 89.37. Gold changed -6.65% to 3,493.2. Bitcoin changed -1.92% to 57,667.2812. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.83%, a relative move of -4.66%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-11.12%) and Goldman Sachs (-10.94%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: UniCredit agrees deal with Berlin on Commerzbank takeover (FT World). Move clears major obstacle for Italian lender to take control of Germany’s second-largest bank after two-year battle Deals and capital markets: SpaceX-Tesla: the directors negotiating the biggest merger ever (FT Home). Five executives are charged with combining Elon Musk’s sprawling enterprises into a potential $3.5tn colossus Central banks and macro: Argentina expected to suffer technical recession in blow to Milei (FT World). President’s crusade against inflation weighs down economy as he prepares to mount re-election bid next year Central banks and macro: Oil loses grip on bond markets as inflation ‘virus’ spreads (FT Markets). Tight correlation between crude prices and borrowing costs has broken down Geopolitics and trade: Opec+’s largest members head for clash over oil production estimates (FT Markets). Analysts expect Sunday’s meeting of the cartel and its allies to be ‘one of the most complicated in years’ as global markets swing back into oversupply
